messages:
Lydia Grant: Quick ask — we need a tight, customer-facing preflight for three renewal-risk tenants. Goal: 1 page, fillable by their engs, with 3 runnable checks (cache hit, batch perf loop, streaming smoke), a tiny 'telemetry anchors' list of graphs we need, and a line-to-action mapping for renewal signals. Keep it skimmable for AMs.

Marco Silva: I'd do a short form + three pasteable commands. Add thresholds inline so engs know what's worrying. Suggested thresholds: cache_hit < 25% -> high priority; p95 > 700ms -> ops deep-dive; error_rate > 1.5% -> escalate to SRE.

Jin Ho: Streaming guidance: recommend enabling streaming for flows with median > 250ms or p95 > 400ms. Short snippet for customers: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" \
  -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
And a minimal config they can paste to us:
```
{"cache_prefix":"tenant-abc","cache_ttl_secs":1800,"batch_size":4,"enable_streaming":true}
```

Priyanka Rao: Telemetry anchors to ask for (one-line each): cache_hit_rate (7d), kv_miss_rate, p95 latency (24h), queued_requests, error_rate (4xx/5xx), billing spikes (7d). Also include a tiny signal->AM action table:
- low cache_hit -> suggest prefix caching + increase TTL -> schedule 30m optimization call
- rising p95 -> run batch/concurrency audit -> ops deep-dive
- billing disputes/large usage variance -> finance + billing review

Lydia Grant: Pasteable preflight form for AMs to email (one-liners):
---
TENANT PREFLIGHT (please complete)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name/email):
- Affected endpoint(s / routes):
- Cache strategy (prefix/response/shared KV):
- Cache TTL(s) observed (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- batch_size (min/max):
- streaming enabled? (y/n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- error rate (24h):
- recent config changes (14d):
- Priority flows (1-3):
---

Marco Silva: Runnable quick-checks to paste: 
1) streaming smoke test (curl) — use the snippet above
2) p95 loop (bash): 
```
for i in {1..20}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done
```
3) cache header check:
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | grep -i cache
```

Priyanka Rao: Quick "what to change now" checklist to include for customers:
- Increase cache_ttl to 1800	600s for stable prompts
- Move repetitive prompts to prefix caching
- Reduce batch_size to 1-4 for UI-interactive flows
- Enable streaming for median >250ms flows
- Prefer warm-pools/autoscale burst over huge batch_size for short spikes

ops_bot: Tip: run `/autofill-metrics <account>` to populate cache_hit, p95, and error_rate fields automatically.

Lydia Grant: This looks great. Can someone produce a one-page PDF + plain-text email snippet by EOD? Assign to Marco and tag ops_bot to create a tracking ticket.

ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-PRFL-5570	6 assigned to Marco Silva.

Marco Silva: I'll draft the PDF and attach small sample graphs (cache_hit trend + p95 timeseries). Will post here in ~3 hours.
